name: bf-income-tax
description: Burkina Faso business income tax reference for the 2026 tax year, covering individuals with commercial, industrial, agricultural or non-commercial professional income. Use for IBICA, IBNC, progressive annual profit bands, minimum tax, CGA reductions, turnover regimes, CME contributions and the election from a microenterprise regime to real-profit taxation. It distinguishes accrual business profit from the professional receipts-and-paid-expenses base, and separates statutory return preparation from unverified electronic filing details. Two executable cases compare ordinary tax with the applicable minimum and the cost of a regime election. Personal employment tax, investment income, rental income and treaty residence require their own analysis.
